description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Glasspool Mimic.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Glasspool Mimic and another permanent you control.
Activate Glasspool Mimic by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
